notes: 107 building materials with a 1.0 recipe (94 from the planner's 118-entry block catalogue, 13 new in 1.0), plus 29 catalogue terrain materials and 4 new 1.0 terrain materials that have no recipe and are listed under resources as gathered (with catalogueName where the names differ). Source: enshrouded.tools item pages, read from the 1.0 game files (footer: 'Data from game build 25988036'), cross-checked against the site's building-blocks table (tiers, per-craft yields) and its 1.0 page, which diffs the last Early Access build (23966345) against 1.0. Every recipe is likely-1.0 (datamined, not checked in game). changes1_0 compares the 1.0 recipe with the pre-1.0 wiki recipe in tools/blocks-src/recipes.json ('old -> new', '+ item qty' added, '- item qty' dropped); recipeChanged1_0 is the site's own diff against the last Early Access build. Where the two disagree, the item is flagged: a wiki-only difference means the wiki was stale or wrong before 1.0. The input 'Fired Brick' is 'Fired Bricks' in 1.0 (a rename, same item). station is the station the recipe uses (Workbench, Grinding Stones); crafter is null for the player's own Workbench and the survivor (Farmer) otherwise; requires is [] because no page shows a requirement. Yields: blocks 100, roofs 50, roads, soils, fertile dirts and rubbles 10, all read from each page's 'Makes' line. tier is the site's building tier (biome); roads and soils have none. Rubbles are timed Grinding Stones recipes (70-80s). Resources follow each input's primary recipe (the one its 'Where to get it' line names) down to raw materials; alternatives are in otherRecipes. Resource recipes carry the site's diff (changed1_0) and, where the pre-1.0 intermediates list has the same station, a wiki comparison (changes1_0). The site's 'About' blurbs quote Early Access and are ignored (e.g. Revelwood Stone's still says Workbench, Blackmire Rubble's says no recipe). The site also lists 5 Overgrowth paints (Ivy, Climbing Rose, Mycelium, Wisteria, Underwater Overgrowth; Farmer, 100 per craft) that are not in the catalogue and not new in 1.0, so they are left out. Left out as not hammer materials: Ancient Column Block, Red Marble Column Block (new 1.0 furniture props, Decoration Workbench).

items.name: Fired Bricks Block
changes1_0: Input renamed Fired Brick -> Fired Bricks

items.name: Well Block
flags: Odd: a Kindlewastes (tier 4) block that now takes plain Stone instead of Sandstone, the opposite of 1.0's 'use the biome's stone' change. The site's 1.0 diff confirms it.

items.name: Weathered Ancient Stone Block
flags: Conversion recipe: 100 Ancient Stone Block + 5 Blackmire Stone make 100, so it costs a full stack of Ancient Stone Block plus the stone.

items.name: Brick-Timbered Block
flags: Uses 1 Fired Bricks Block (the building block, itself crafted 100 at a time), not loose Fired Bricks. The pre-1.0 data marked this as suspicious; the 1.0 data confirms it.

items.name: Ectoplasm Block
flags: Tier conflict: Keen's 1.0 changelog (as quoted on enshrouded.tools/1-0) says it is 'now a tier 2 building material', but the site's building-blocks table puts it in tier 3, Nomad Highlands.

items.name: Roof Tiles Block
changes1_0: Input renamed Fired Brick -> Fired Bricks

items.name: Blackmire Rubble
flags: The pre-1.0 wiki said it had no recipe, unlike the other biome rubbles, and the site's (Early Access) About blurb says the same, but the 1.0 data has a Grinding Stones recipe. It isn't in the site's changed-recipe list, so it is probably one of 1.0's 617 new recipes.
